title: ExpectedLabReport
description: Ground-truth annotation for one OCR lab report sample. Must never contain real patient PHI.

hospital.description: Hospital identifier matching the folder name under benchmark/ or golden/

report_type.description: Type of medical report. Currently only lab_result is supported.

language.description: Primary language of the source document

test_date.description: Date of lab tests in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

uploaded_by.description: How this ground truth was produced

anonymized.description: True = patient name, DOB, ID number, address removed from image before storage

contains_phi.description: Must be false for any file committed to git. Files with contains_phi=true must not be committed.

row_index.description: 1-based row index in the original OCR table

original_test_name.description: Verbatim test name as printed on the lab report

display_name_vi.description: Vietnamese display name shown to the patient

mapped_metric_type.description: Canonical metric_type key. Null if not yet mapped.

unit.description: Unit as printed on the report (not canonicalized)

reference_range.description: Reference range string as printed. Null if absent.

status.description: Clinical status relative to reference range
